stem: A random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(2.4)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Two independent values of $X$ are chosen.

Find the probability that both of these values are greater than 1.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: It is given that $\text{P}(X = r) < \text{P}(X = r + 1)$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the set of possible values of $r$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Hence find the value of $r$ for which $\text{P}(X = r)$ is greatest.
